hypothesis: The measurements support separate costs for upward movement, shallow root insertion, and list growth. Replacing the tie feature with incoming priority provides sufficient distinct states while retaining the dominant measured cost distinctions.

pcvs.name: first_sift_swap
pcvs.rationale: Separates insertions that move upward from those that stop at the first parent.

pcvs.name: shallow_root_insertion
pcvs.rationale: Distinguishes the shallow root insertions, which had higher measured costs than the deeper sift.

pcvs.name: list_capacity_exhausted
pcvs.rationale: Captures the observed extra cost of backing-list growth on 64-bit Python.

pcvs.name: incoming_priority
pcvs.rationale: Retains the raw ordering key and supplies twelve distinct entry states, resolving the previous state-count failure.
